READ THIS FIRST

   1. THIS ZIP CONTAINS LIVE CREDENTIALS. Do not forward it, upload it to a
      drive/email, or leave it in Downloads; delete the zip after installing.
      (Daman's own rule for the bundle-builder: generated zips never get
      committed or publicly deployed.)
   2. Where to unzip — Mac: your home folder, i.e. ~/jivo-cli, NOT
      Documents/Desktop/Downloads (macOS blocks remote-support access there).
      Windows: a short path without spaces, e.g. C:\jivo-cli.
   3. Mac first run: run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/jivo-cli` once, or
      every binary will be blocked as 'unidentified developer'; if a command
      says 'permission denied', `chmod +x` it.
   4. This kit is a standalone bundle, NOT a git checkout of the toolkit, so
      there is no harness/ folder and no setup.py to run — skip that step if
      a colleague mentions it. One consequence: if you write to SAP, the audit
      log lands in your home folder (~/.sapb1-writes.jsonl) instead of the
      shared history. Start at the doctor command for your tool, below.
   5. Second command: your department's doctor from the SETUP.md table (e.g.
      Accounts Mac: ./sap-b1/cli/sapb1 doctor). Green = ready. Red =
      credentials or network, message Daman — do not guess.
   6. Network: SAP and HANA answers need the office network, the FortiClient
      VPN, or the tunnel this kit was configured with — from plain home
      Wi-Fi the SAP doctor WILL fail even with perfect credentials. Everything
      else (sales/factory/ecom/imports/ops portals) works from any internet.
   7. Logins expire: ecom/oms/factory/control-panel sessions last about a day
      — the re-login one-liners are in the root README 'Credentials & auth'
      section (or your box got a scheduled refresh task).
   8. Reading is safe everywhere and changes nothing. SAP is the only writable
      system, only via draft/post/patch typed by you, always previewing and
      requiring the full word 'yes'. If a write ever says 'outcome unknown'
      (exit 7): STOP, do not re-run, check SAP, tell Daman.
   9. Windows users: use `python` not `python3`; imports (exim) needs Git
      Bash; write payloads are easier via --data-file than escaped quotes.
  10. Don't edit CLAUDE.md, .claude/, or harness/bin — the daily sync
      reverts and reports it. Don't copy your credential files anywhere else.
  11. If an answer looks wrong, say so in the chat — corrections you make
      reach every other operator's copy by the next day.

WHAT IS IN THIS KIT

  - HANA SQL (direct SAP database) — Run read-only SQL straight into SAP
    B1's HANA database (Oil/Mart/Beverages schemas)
  - JSAP ops platform — Query JIVO's internal JSAP ops platform from the
    terminal

FIRST RUN

   1. Unzip into your HOME folder so you end up with ~/jivo-cli — not
      Documents, Desktop or Downloads. macOS blocks remote support from those
      three folders.
   2. Open Terminal and run: cd ~/jivo-cli
   3. Clear the download quarantine, once, or macOS blocks every tool as an
      'unidentified developer':
          xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/jivo-cli
   4. If a command says 'permission denied', restore the execute bit:
          chmod +x \
            ~/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql \
            ~/jivo-cli/jsap-cli/jsap-cli
   5. Lock the credential files down: on Mac `chmod 600 $(find ~/jivo-cli
      -name '*.env')`; on Windows leave them where they are and do not copy
      them anywhere.
   6. Run the offline check for your tool from its section below. That proves
      the tool runs. Then run its doctor, which also proves the network and
      the credentials.

NETWORK — WHICH TOOLS NEED WHAT

  - SAP B1 and HANA: office LAN, the FortiClient VPN profile 'Mieux', or the
    tunnel this kit was configured with. From plain home Wi-Fi the SAP doctor
    WILL fail even though the credentials are perfect — that is the network,
    not the kit.
  - Everything else (sales, factory, ecom, imports, ops portals, DSR, control
    panel): any internet connection, home or office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HANA SQL (DIRECT SAP DATABASE)

  Run read-only SQL straight into SAP B1's HANA database (Oil/Mart/Beverages
  schemas) — real SUM/GROUP BY/JOIN, so a turnover or balance is one query
  returning one number; also serves a read-only MCP server for AI clients.

  HOW TO RUN IT
    Run it from anywhere inside ~/jivo-cli — it finds its own settings by
    looking upward through the folders.
    Included here: ./hana-sql/hana-sql

  CREDENTIALS
    Ready to use — the credentials are in this kit and the tool reads them
    itself.
    Both connection variants ship: connections/hana.env (direct, office
    network) and connections/hana-tunnel.env (from home, through the tunnel).
    hana-sql walks UP from wherever you run it to find connections/hana.env
    — so keep the folder layout, and to use the tunnel variant copy it over
    connections/hana.env.

  CHECK IT WORKS (no network needed)
    ./hana-sql --help (Windows: hana-sql.exe --help) — prints full usage
    without any network or env file; note it exits 2 (stdlib flag help
    convention), so check the usage text, not the exit code. Alternatively
    './hana-sql "DELETE FROM X"' exits 1 with a guard refusal before any
    credential is read or connection attempted.

  WORTH KNOWING
    - To switch between office and home routes, copy
      connections/hana-tunnel.env over connections/hana.env (keep a copy of
      the original first).
    - --help exits with code 2. That is normal for this tool — if you see
      the usage text, it works.
    - hana-sql: HANA (103.89.45.192:30015) is IP-whitelisted to the office,
      same as SAP. The bundle ships both connections/hana.env (direct) and
      connections/hana-tunnel.env (from-home) — the recipient uses whichever
      matches their route.
    - hana-sql: the database credential is a FULL SAP user (ZIA), not a
      read-only account. The tool's guard is read-only, the credential is not
      — hand it out accordingly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
JSAP OPS PLATFORM

  Query JIVO's internal JSAP ops platform from the terminal — tickets,
  tasks, bill verification, inventory audits, budgets, hierarchy and
  dashboards — strictly read-only.

  HOW TO RUN IT
    cd ~/jivo-cli/jsap-cli — this tool reads its credentials from the folder
    you are standing in, so run it from there.
    Included here: ./jsap-cli/jsap-cli

  CREDENTIALS
    Ready to use — the credentials are in this kit and the tool reads them
    itself.
    jsap walks up from jsap-cli/jsap/ and finds the bundle's root .env —
    nothing to configure.

  CHECK IT WORKS (no network needed)
    cd jsap-cli && ./jsap-cli --help (or: python3 -m jsap --help; verified
    exit 0, no network touched). Deeper check: python3 tests/test_readonly.py
    -> '6/6 read-only checks passed'

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WARNINGS FROM THIS BUILD

  - env-vault/all-env.txt was publicly readable on GitHub (verified
    2026-08-05) — treat every credential in this bundle as burn-listed until
    it has been rotated. env-vault/ itself is never bundled.
  - hana-sql: HANA (103.89.45.192:30015) is IP-whitelisted to the office, same
    as SAP. The bundle ships both connections/hana.env (direct) and
    connections/hana-tunnel.env (from-home) — the recipient uses whichever
    matches their route.
  - hana-sql: the database credential is a FULL SAP user (ZIA), not a
    read-only account. The tool's guard is read-only, the credential is not
    — hand it out accordingly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF SOMETHING IS WRONG

  - A red doctor is almost always credentials or network, in that order.
    Message Daman with the exact command and the exact message — do not
    guess and do not retry a write.
  - If an answer looks wrong, say so in the chat. Corrections you make reach
    every other operator's copy by the next day.
  - Delete the zip once this folder is in place. Keep the folder; the
    credentials inside it are live.
